title: Surgically induced astigmatism and posterior corneal curvature changes following phacoemulsification

indication: Senile cataract (age over 40 years) graded by LOCS III (Results: group 1 NS I 7, NS II 29, NS III 18, NS IV 9, NS V 2; group 2 NS I 2, NS II 25, NS III 25, NS IV 7, NS V 6); pterygium grade II-III, corneal opacity, uveitis or other inflammatory eye disease, complicated or traumatic cataract, diabetic retinopathy, previous ocular surgery and irregular astigmatism excluded

groups.description: Group 1: uncomplicated phacoemulsification (Oertli system) with foldable IOL through a 2.2-mm clear corneal incision; randomized (computer-generated random number table)
Group 2: the same phacoemulsification technique and foldable IOL through a 2.8-mm clear corneal incision

series.baseline_label: Preoperative pachymetry (Table 4 row 'Pachymetry' Group 1 'Mean±SD', column 'Preoperative'); Pentacam (Methods)
series.notes: Table 4 columns Preoperative, Week 1, Week 3, Week 6 (weeks x 7/30.4375); mean ± SD in µm; per-visit n not reported

series.baseline_label: Preoperative pachymetry (Table 4 row 'Pachymetry' Group 2 'Mean±SD', column 'Preoperative'); Pentacam (Methods)
series.notes: Table 4 columns Preoperative, Week 1, Week 3, Week 6 (weeks x 7/30.4375); mean ± SD in µm; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.what: Table 5 'Pachymetry change (Pre-Op - Week 1)' by cataract grade and group
exclusions.reason: Change at a single time without the subgroup's reference CCT; not admissible

exclusions.what: Table 4 rows UCVA, SE and BCVA; Tables 1-3 (surgically induced astigmatism and corneal curvature)

notes: Randomized prospective interventional study of 130 eyes of 130 patients, 65 per group; dropouts and per-visit n are not reported.
Role: two standard clear-corneal incision sizes compared without an investigational agent or a declared experimental arm, so both groups are control.

Table 4 labels the value 'Pachymetry' and Methods state that corneal topography and pachymetry were evaluated with the Pentacam; the pachymetry location (apex, pupil centre or thinnest point) is not stated. Taken as the central corneal thickness admitted by triage. Flagged for review.
